# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Mask filtered glyph fixes**

## Highlights

The unreleased 4.156.2 changes correct mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads return different glyph data.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Mask-filtered glyph rendering corrected** — When consecutive font-scaler loads disagree about a glyph's path, format, or bounds, rendering now uses the reloaded path and avoids incompatible mask copies. Clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides, preventing stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
